comments.text: Chukotka feels like one of the last truly untouched frontiers on Earth! ❄🐻‍❄ The fact that woolly mammoths survived on Wrangel Island until just 4,000 years ago is absolutely mind-blowing. From abandoned Soviet towns to isolated Arctic villages, this documentary reveals a world most people will never experience. Truly fascinating!
